import json, os, resource, subprocess, sys, time
WORK="/workspace/scratch/work3"
man=json.load(open(os.path.join(WORK,"max.json")))
# build a ~90 MiB log with 300000 physical lines
rows=[]
for i in range(300000):
    rows.append(json.dumps({"probe_id":"w0/s0/0/low-1/0"+"z"*180,"received_ms":i,"target":"2001:db8:0:0::1",
                            "source":"2001:db8:0:0::1","type":129,"code":0,"pad":"p"*40}))
# strip pad (not allowed key) -> keep six keys only
rows=[json.dumps({"probe_id":"w0/s0/0/low-1/0"+"z"*180,"received_ms":i,"target":"2001:db8:0:0::1",
                  "source":"2001:db8:0:0::1","type":129,"code":0}) for i in range(300000)]
data="\n".join(rows)+"\n"
p=os.path.join(WORK,"fat.jsonl")
open(p,"w").write(data)
print("log size MiB:", len(data)/1048576)
t0=time.time()
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"/app/submission/ipv6_replay.py","replay",os.path.join(WORK,"max.json"),p],capture_output=True)
t1=time.time()
ru=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
print("rc",r.returncode,"time %.1fs"%(t1-t0),"maxrss MiB %.1f"%(ru.ru_maxrss/1024))
print("stdout bytes",len(r.stdout), r.stderr[:200])
